comments.text:
Random nitpick; at 28:34, Alberta is 4 timezones away from Newfoundland. 3 1/2 if you want to get technical, I guess.

Edit: at 31:47, Alberta has 4 provinces between it and Newfoundland: Quebec, Ontario, Manitoba, and Saskatchewan. More if you go through the Maritimes.

You're bad at geography, apparently.

comments.text: I really liked this video; just curious, but at 14:37, that's not anywhere in Newfoundland. I don't think that's even anywhere in Canada.

replies.text: Couple more shots around 25:08. I get using stock clips for stuff like people eating or fish but nature shots from tropical locales is an odd choice to intersperse with actual shots from Newfoundland.
